title: CrowdSec Fleet
description: Operational assurance: current agents, remediation, CAPI and Cloudflare freshness. Engine host filters do not scope central LAPI or fleet health.

options.content: **Engine host** filters engine panels. LAPI, bouncer and health panels deliberately remain fleet-wide. **N/A is not healthy or zero.** Health results older than 11 minutes are excluded. Historical graphs and retained alert records are not new attacks. The private email report supplies source IP, country, ASN and service/host investigations; these are not exposed by native engine metrics.

panels.title: Overall operational health
panels.description: HEALTHY: protection and maintenance checks pass. ATTENTION: nginx maintenance or update/verification warnings with core fleet online. CRITICAL: an expected agent/bouncer, engine scrape, LAPI or core collection is unhealthy. Missing/stale input is N/A, never healthy.

panels.title: Active LAPI decision records
panels.description: Records, not necessarily distinct IPs or blocked requests. Includes community/list origins.

panels.title: Retained alert records
panels.description: Current database retention, not a rolling-24-hour detection count.

panels.title: Every monitored agent
panels.description: Current expected machine health; includes absent registrations as failed.

panels.title: Current failure reasons
panels.description: Only active failures emit this metric. No rows means no recorded failure reasons, provided the health snapshot is fresh.

panels.title: CAPI last verified age
panels.description: Age of a successful verification, not an authentication probe from this dashboard.

panels.title: Community list freshness
panels.description: NEEDS REFRESH is a real freshness warning, not an outage of every agent. See saved retry and current failure reason. Never means a refresh is currently running.

panels.title: Saved next bulk attempt
panels.description: Read-only saved quota retry. Viewing does not retry, reset or advance it.

panels.title: Community candidates omitted
panels.description: Capacity exclusions, not blocked Cloudflare requests.

panels.title: HTTP gateway synchronization
panels.description: Local decision sync health. Also review central sync-status and bootstrap checks above for freshness.

options.content: Cloudflare list freshness, LAPI polling and actual request blocking are separate signals. Current metrics do **not** expose Cloudflare WAF request/challenge totals or per-IP/geo events. Host firewalls protect direct connections; tunnel traffic requires HTTP/edge enforcement. No AppSec/WAF engine metrics are configured, so empty AppSec panels are intentionally not shown.

panels.title: Bouncer pulls — selected range
panels.description: Reset-aware request estimates, not blocked traffic.

panels.title: Agent alert POSTs — selected range
panels.description: POST requests may contain multiple alerts; not the number of detections.

panels.title: Engine versions
panels.description: Version is a label. cs_info intentionally has numeric value zero; that is not a health failure.

panels.title: Scenario overflows — selected range
panels.description: Overflows can include tests/internal sources; not confirmed external attackers.

panels.title: Observed process start changes — selected range
panels.description: Observed changes only; restarts between scrapes may be missed.

panels.title: Nginx automatic update status
panels.description: Current native controller + independent watcher evidence. No change is a successful check, not a deployed upgrade. Same-pin acceptance is validation. In progress requires a running native service; stale evidence is not healthy.

panels.title: Pending nginx advisory reviews
panels.description: Unacknowledged advisory revisions, not CVE counts. An out-of-policy candidate also sets REVIEW NEEDED even when this is zero.

panels.title: Failed automatic transactions — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic journal outcomes: rejected preflight, incomplete recovery, or rollback. Excludes acceptance/rehearsal/audit. Failures before journaling are visible in current status, not this count.

panels.title: Production rollbacks — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic transactions with a changed candidate and completed rollback. Also included in failed transaction count; not additive. Incomplete rollback is RECOVERY REQUIRED, not completed rollback.

panels.title: Controller last check age
panels.description: Daily result may be up to 26 hours old; five-minute observation freshness is enforced separately. STALE after 26 hours.

panels.title: Watcher findings
panels.description: Registry, advisory or source/runtime/Internal Dockhand drift findings. Unknown/stale watcher evidence is N/A, not zero.

panels.title: Retained history complete
panels.description: Reader bound is 512 journals, 64 KiB each. Any missing/malformed/unsafe record or overflow makes counts unavailable instead of silently undercounting.

panels.title: Nginx transactions — fixed rolling 24h
panels.description: Rolling gauges, not lifetime counters: do not use increase(). Validation failures are separate from automatic failures. Counts use each journal latest write time, not the selected Grafana range.

panels.title: Latest recorded nginx transaction
panels.description: Mode, phase and outcome of the latest durable transaction. Can precede an in-progress validation or a blocked attempt that did not create a journal. A validation activation is not a production upgrade.

panels.title: Last verified production upgrade
panels.description: Latest retained automatic completed transaction with a changed image. N/A when none is recorded; not the last acceptance or no-change check.

panels.title: Last completed production rollback
panels.description: Latest retained completed automatic rollback of a changed image. N/A when none is recorded. Incomplete recovery is shown as a separate current failure.

options.content: Seven owned nginx guards use this controller. The independent watcher checks runtime, canonical Ansible and Internal Dockhand definitions. This collector only reads existing records; it never deploys images, retries Cloudflare or changes timers. **Pending review** and **waiting for image age** are deliberate gates. **Rolled back** means recovery completed, not that the candidate was repaired. Same-pin acceptance/rehearsal/audit runs remain separate. Transaction counts are a fixed rolling **24 hours**, using each retained journal’s latest write, not an exhaustive event log. Pre-journal failed attempts appear in current status only. Missing/incomplete history is N/A, not zero. Observation freshness is 11 minutes; daily check freshness is 26 hours. Core protection health and maintenance warnings remain distinct.
